name: dsh-host-fs
description: Delete and move files from the DSH host process — including paths outside the workspace, where DSH's own fs tools have no delete and the sandboxed shell cannot write. Gated by a session allow/deny list and a path allow/deny list. · 在宿主进程里删除/移动文件，补上 DSH 文件工具没有的删除与工作区外 shell 写不进去的那一格；带会话闸门与路径闸门。

scripts.test: node test/guard.test.mjs && node test/settings.test.mjs && node test/client-syntax.test.mjs
